payload.reason: The evidence provides information about the performance of models compared to a baseline, specifically in terms of Word Error Rate (WER) and Phoneme Error Rate (PER).

claims.text: The baseline refers to the performance of the wFST-adaptation approach and other models against which the LangID and NoLangID models are compared.
The LangID and NoLangID models outperform the baseline in WER and WER 100 metrics, indicating their effectiveness compared to the baseline.
